title: Half a Deposit, Reserve Untouched
story: The landlord wanted the full winter deposit before the heating contract could start. The cafe reserve could cover it, but that fund was for a broken oven or a quiet month, not for a cost the season would bring anyway. Jonah offered half now and half when the first cold orders arrived, and he showed weekly takings rather than a bare promise. The landlord agreed, provided a missed second payment restored the full demand at once. Jonah accepted because the reserve stayed ready for a shock. Spending emergency money on a predictable bill would have left the cafe confident on paper and fragile on the week something failed.

quiz.supportingSentence: The cafe reserve could cover it, but that fund was for a broken oven or a quiet month, not for a cost the season would bring anyway.

quiz.explanation: The contrast weighs paper confidence against how fragile the cafe would be in a real failure.
quiz.supportingSentence: Spending emergency money on a predictable bill would have left the cafe confident on paper and fragile on the week something failed.
